prompt:

Facts from the call: the client agreed to move the launch to 14 March; the payment screen redesign was discussed but not decided; Priya (client) will send the brand guidelines by Friday.

task.prompt:
An AI tool summarised a client call. Compare it with the facts below and mark the lines in the summary that are wrong or invented.

Facts from the call: the client agreed to move the launch to 14 March; the payment screen redesign was discussed but not decided; Priya (client) will send the brand guidelines by Friday.

segments.text: Decision: the payment screen will be redesigned.
segments.issue: It was discussed, not decided; the AI turned a discussion into a decision.

segments.text: Action: Priya sends brand guidelines by Friday.
Action: Lee delivers the new payment design by Monday.
Next call: same time next week.

prompt: Order the steps for using an AI tool to produce meeting notes for a client call.

task.prompt: Order the steps for using an AI tool to produce meeting notes for a client call.

items.label: Check the tool is approved for this client's data and get consent to record
Generate a draft summary of decisions, actions and open questions
Check every decision, owner and date against the transcript
Send the reviewed notes to attendees

task.explanation: Permission first; then capture; draft; verify; and only then share.

prompt: A client asks at the start of a call whether it is being recorded for AI notes. Your team usually records every call.

task.prompt: A client asks at the start of a call whether it is being recorded for AI notes. Your team usually records every call.

steps.question: What do you do?
options: Explain the AI note-taking, ask for their consent, and do not record if they decline
Record anyway since it's routine
Say it's not recorded and record it
End the call
steps.explanation: Consent is needed before recording; honesty is non-negotiable.

steps.question: They decline. How do you capture the notes?
options: Record on your phone instead
Skip notes for this call
Take notes manually and send them for confirmation after the call
Ask a colleague to record secretly
steps.explanation: Respect the decision and still capture outcomes.

prompt: A PM wrote this prompt for summarising a call transcript. Mark the parts that will make the summary less reliable or less safe.

task.prompt: A PM wrote this prompt for summarising a call transcript. Mark the parts that will make the summary less reliable or less safe.

segments.text: Summarise the transcript below for the client.
List decisions, owners and dates only where they are stated in the transcript.
If something is unclear, make a reasonable guess so the notes look complete.
segments.issue: Encourages invention; ask the model to mark unclear items as open questions instead.

segments.text: Here is the transcript, plus the client's full customer database export for context.
segments.issue: Unnecessary personal data shared with the tool; include only what the task needs.

prompt: A PM measures time saved by AI meeting notes over a month.

task.prompt: A PM measures time saved by AI meeting notes over a month.
task.explanation: 20 minutes saved per call x 20 = 400 minutes = 6.7 hours. Review time stays in the plan.

prompt: These items appeared in an AI-generated summary. Rank them by how carefully you must verify them before sending, most first.

task.prompt: These items appeared in an AI-generated summary. Rank them by how carefully you must verify them before sending, most first.
task.explanation: Money and commitments create the biggest disputes if wrong; ownership matters for follow-through; the topic rarely causes harm.

prompt: What is the most important step before sending AI-generated meeting notes to a client?

options: Check decisions, owners, dates and numbers against what was actually said
Make the formatting consistent
Add more detail
Send quickly so the client sees them
mcq.explanation: AI summaries can merge speakers or turn suggestions into decisions; the PM is responsible for accuracy.

prompt: Which AI tool should you use for a client's call transcripts?

options: Any free tool that works well
Your personal account
One the company has approved for that client's data
Whichever tool the client mentions
mcq.explanation: Tool terms differ on data use; client contracts may restrict sharing.

prompt: An AI summary lists a decision you do not remember being made. What should you do?

options: Keep it; the AI heard it
Delete the whole summary
Check the transcript; if it was not decided, move it to open questions
Ask the AI if it is sure
mcq.explanation: The source is the transcript, not the model's confidence.
